uzo.purpose: Builds one page of an application: the title a person reads first and the focus lands on after a change of route, the badges and the line beside it, the actions on the page and its sections — in the order a screen reader lists them.

instead.kialo: The frame around the pages is the sxelo, because it stays while the pages change; the page is what changes.

boundary.kialo: A list with its detail beside it is a page type of round 2, because the two panes share the width by a rule of their own; a person decides until it comes.
A dashboard of tiles is a page type of round 2, because its grid of cards follows a layout of its own; a person decides until it comes.

containers.name: shell
containers.kialo: A page stands in the main of the sxelo, because the shell stays while the pages change.

with.kialo: The title is a titolo of level 1, focusable, because it names the page and takes the focus after a change of route.
A badge beside the title says the status of what the page shows, because a status is read at a glance.
The subtitle is a teksto, because one sentence says what the page is about.
An action on the page is a butono, one with emphasis high at most (one-primary-per-container).
A way to another page beside the title is a ligilo, because a destination is a link, not an action.
Further actions, and a destructive one, go into a menuo, because they are not the page's first action.
